components.name: Reading Paragraph
components.description: Body text at the measure, a classical Chinese quotation in Songti inside the page language's quotation marks, and the source line that closes the paragraph with a quiet link to the PDF page.
components.html: In the Book of Han (first century CE), the abdication charge from the Analects is transcribed almost verbatim: “咨爾舜，天之歷數在爾躬” (the heaven-ordained succession rests upon your person). A few chapters later, in the biography of the usurper Wang Mang, the same line reappears as “歷數在于予躬”, the second-person pronoun quietly rewritten into the first. By the 260s, in the abdication documents of the Records of the Three Kingdoms, only a formulaic skeleton survives, “天祿永終，歷數在晉”, detached from the Analects and fused into the standard script of dynastic transfer. A text-reuse detector can find that all three resemble the Analects. It cannot say that the first is a faithful citation, the second an appropriation of authority, the third a dead formula. Source: Introduction · PDF p. 1

narrative.overview:
The page is set the way a collated text is marked up: ink on white paper, annotation in indigo, and vermilion only where a mark is stamped. It inherits the visual world of the Explorer, the public site that shows every intertextual pair in its context, and carries it to the paper page, whose English and Chinese versions share one structure, one layout and one set of tokens.

Density is that of a scholarly reading page. A 45rem column carries the argument at a measured line length, and on wide screens a 17.5rem margin carries the paper's numbers. Type is the reader's own system sans at reading sizes, with weight rather than size doing most of the work of hierarchy; Songti appears only where classical Chinese is quoted. Structure is drawn with hairlines, never lifted with shadows or boxed into cards. Color carries meaning or stays out: indigo marks where the reader can act and where the reader is, vermilion is the seal and the question numerals, and everything else is ink.

The product rejects marketing rhetoric (gradients, oversized slogans, stacks of cards), false-precision numbers, and color that carries no meaning.
keyCharacteristics: White paper, ink text, indigo annotation and vermilion marks, with a paired dark theme that follows the reader's system setting.
One platform sans for everything read or operated; Songti for classical Chinese quotations only.
A 45rem reading column beside a 17.5rem margin, with the measure set per language: 34em in English, 37em in Chinese.
Hairline rules and three flat grounds for structure; no shadows, gradients or cards.
Numbers set as text, on tabular figures wherever they are compared.

rules.name: The Two Marks Rule
rules.body: Vermilion stamps two things: the scroll seal and the question numerals. Links, emphasis, highlights, glance numbers and the page's own rules and grounds never take it. The paper's figures keep their published colors on their white plates.

rules.name: The Annotation Rule
rules.body: Indigo appears only where the reader can act or where the reader is: running-text links, the page list, the link row, the copy button, the focus ring, selection, hovered controls and the deployment model's row. Links that support the reading rather than lead it stay muted until pointed at, author names stay ink, and no text takes indigo for emphasis, however important it is.

rules.name: The Paired Theme Rule
rules.body: Every color token except Plate White has a dark counterpart, switched by the reader's system setting, and every text pair clears WCAG AA in both themes; the closest pair, indigo on indigo wash in the dark theme, reads 5.9:1.

rules.name: The Reading Face Rule
rules.body: One platform sans sets the title, the headings, the reading text and every control, and weight 650 against 400 does most of the work of hierarchy. On the page the title stops at 2.3rem. The system has no display voice; a surface that needs one gets it from a change of direction, never by enlarging the platform sans.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Reading text runs to 34em in English and 37em in Chinese, counted in the em of the element that sets it: 578px for body text, 646px for a lead sentence and 476px for a caption in English, and 629px, 703px and 518px in Chinese.

rules.name: The Song Rule
rules.body: Classical Chinese quotations, and nothing else, are set in Songti, in the script of their source edition, inside the quotation marks of the page language: curly quotes in English prose, 「」 in Chinese prose.

rules.name: The Margin Rule
rules.body: The margin column holds "At a glance" on the first screen and lends its width to wide figures and tables below it. Nothing else goes there, and below 68rem it folds back into the column.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn, never lifted: 1px rules in the hairline color separate the masthead, the page list, the margin column, table rows, the footer and every frame. The only heavier lines are the 1.5px muted-ink rules under a table's header row and under its last body row.

rules.name: The Quiet Secondary Rule
rules.body: A link that supports the reading (a source, a PDF page, a full-size image, another language) recedes in muted ink with a hairline underline and turns indigo only when pointed at.

dos: **Do** keep vermilion (#b2392b, dark #e87a65) to the scroll seal and the question numerals.

**Do** use indigo only where the reader can act or where the reader is: running-text links, the page list, the link row, the copy button, the focus ring, selection, hovered controls and the deployment model's row.
**Do** set reading text at 1.0625rem with a 1.65 line height and cap it at the language's measure: 34em in English, 37em in Chinese.
**Do** set classical Chinese quotations in the Songti stack, in the script of their source edition, inside the page language's quotation marks.
**Do** put compared numbers on tabular lining figures, and keep a label with its number, a statistic with its value and a number with its unit on one line.
**Do** caption figures below the plate and tables above the frame, with the label in ink at 650 and quiet links to the full-size image or the PDF page.
**Do** keep figure plates white in both themes.
**Do** name every link and control in words; the only drawn glyph is the chevron of the folded page list.
**Do** give every new color token a dark counterpart and keep every text pair at WCAG AA or better in both themes.
donts: **Don't** use vermilion for links, emphasis, highlights, glance numbers, rules or grounds.
**Don't** add shadows, gradients, glass or cards; separate regions with 1px hairlines and the flat grounds.
**Don't** enlarge the platform sans into a display voice or a slogan; on the page the title stops at 2.3rem.
**Don't** number a section that is not a reader's question.
**Don't** give a glance number color, a box or an icon, or show it without its qualifying note.
**Don't** set anything but classical Chinese quotations in Songti, or anything but the BibTeX entry in monospace.
**Don't** round a styled corner past 8px; there are no pills, circles or card radii.
